content: PostgreSQL backup verification best practice: backups are only valuable if restorable - integrity checks (pg_verifybackup for pg_basebackup, pg_restore --list for dumps) are not enough; schedule periodic restore drills that restore into a throwaway instance and run validation queries (row counts, schema checks, latest id continuity), keep audit evidence of each drill, alert on backup AND verification failure, define retention/rotation (e.g. daily 7 / weekly 4 / monthly 6), test the drill designed to fail loudly rather than pass quietly; automate restore tests in CI or cron.
